passages.text: When all this had ended, the Israelites in attendance went out to the cities of Judah and broke up the sacred pillars, chopped down the Asherah poles, and tore down the high places and altars throughout Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the Israelites returned to their cities, each to his own property.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites had gathered in Jerusalem.
They finished celebrating the feast.
After this, the Israelites who were present left Jerusalem.
They went out to the cities of Judah.
They broke the sacred pillars in those cities.
They cut down the Asherah poles.
They tore down the high places.
They destroyed the altars.
They did this in all the land of Judah.
They did this in Benjamin.
They did this in Ephraim.
They did this in Manasseh.
They destroyed all these things completely.
Afterward, every Israelite returned home.
Each person went back to his own property and city.
passages.original: וּכְכַלּ֣וֹת כָּל־ זֹ֗את יָצְא֨וּ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֮ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ וַיְשַׁבְּר֣וּ הַמַּצֵּב֣וֹת וַיְגַדְּע֣וּ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֡ים וַיְנַתְּצ֣וּ אֶת־ הַ֠בָּמוֹת וְאֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֞ת מִכָּל־ יְהוּדָ֧ה וּבִנְיָמִ֛ן וּבְאֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עַד־ לְכַלֵּ֑ה וַיָּשׁ֜וּבוּ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לַאֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ לְעָרֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Hezekiah reestablished the divisions of the priests and Levites—each of them according to their duties as priests or Levites—for the burnt offerings and peace offerings, for ministry, for giving thanks, and for singing praises at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah organized the priests and the Levites.
He divided them into groups.
Each group had its own duties.
He assigned every priest and every Levite to his task.
Some offered burnt offerings.
Some offered peace offerings.
Some served in the temple.
Some gave thanks to God.
Some sang praises to God.
They did these things at the gates of the LORD’s dwelling.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד יְחִזְקִיָּ֡הוּ אֶת־ מַחְלְק֣וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם עַֽל־ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֞ם אִ֣ישׁ׀ כְּפִ֣י עֲבֹדָת֗וֹ לַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְלַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְעֹלָ֖ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְשָׁרֵת֙ וּלְהֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֖י מַחֲנ֥וֹת יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The king contributed from his own possessions for the regular morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, as written in the Law of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah gave gifts from his own wealth.
He gave these gifts for burnt offerings.
He provided for burnt offerings every morning.
He provided for burnt offerings every evening.
He gave for burnt offerings on the Sabbaths.
He gave for burnt offerings on the New Moons.
He gave for burnt offerings on the appointed feasts.
He did all this as the Law of the LORD commanded.
passages.original: וּמְנָת֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ מִן־ רְכוּשׁ֜וֹ לָעֹל֗וֹת לְעֹלוֹת֙ הַבֹּ֣קֶר וְהָעֶ֔רֶב וְהָ֣עֹל֔וֹת לַשַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וְלֶחֳדָשִׁ֣ים וְלַמֹּעֲדִ֑ים כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Moreover, he commanded the people living in Jerusalem to make a contribution for the priests and Levites so that they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah spoke to the people who lived in Jerusalem.
Hezekiah gave them a command.
He told them to give a portion of their goods.
This portion was for the priests and the Levites.
Hezekiah wanted the priests and Levites to receive this support.
He wanted them to be able to devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָעָם֙ לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָתֵ֕ת מְנָ֥ת הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְמַ֥עַן יֶחֶזְק֖וּ בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously provided the firstfruits of the grain, new wine, oil, and honey, and of all the produce of the field, and they brought in an abundance—a tithe of everything.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites heard the king’s command.
They responded quickly.
They brought offerings.
They gave the first part of their grain.
They gave the first part of their new wine.
They gave the first part of their oil.
They gave the first part of their honey.
They brought the firstfruits of all the produce from their fields.
They also brought a tithe of everything.
They gave these gifts in great abundance.
passages.original: וְכִפְרֹ֣ץ הַדָּבָ֗ר הִרְבּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּגָ֗ן תִּיר֤וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָר֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ וְכֹ֖ל תְּבוּאַ֣ת שָׂדֶ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֥ר הַכֹּ֛ל לָרֹ֖ב הֵבִֽיאוּ׃

passages.text: And the Israelites and Judahites who lived in the cities of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things consecrated to the LORD their God, and they laid them in large heaps.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites lived in the cities of Judah.
The Judahites also lived in the cities of Judah.
These Israelites and Judahites brought a tithe of their herds.
They brought a tithe of their flocks.
They brought a tithe of the holy things.
These holy things were set apart for the LORD their God.
They placed all these tithes in large heaps.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה הַיּֽוֹשְׁבִים֮ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ גַּם־ הֵ֗ם מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן וּמַעְשַׂ֣ר קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הֵבִ֕יאוּ וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת עֲרֵמֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: In the third month they began building up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh month.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel brought offerings to the house of the LORD.
They gathered these offerings into large heaps.
They started to build up the heaps in the third month.
They finished building up the heaps in the seventh month.
passages.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הָעֲרֵמ֖וֹת לְיִסּ֑וֹד וּבַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י כִּלּֽוּ׃ס

passages.text: When Hezekiah and his officials came and viewed the heaps, they blessed the LORD and His people Israel.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah came with his officials.
They saw the heaps of offerings.
They blessed the LORD.
They blessed the people of Israel.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ וְהַשָּׂרִ֔ים וַיִּרְא֖וּ אֶת־ הָעֲרֵמ֑וֹת וַֽיְבָרֲכוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and Levites about the heaps, and Azariah, the chief priest of the household of Zadok, answered him, “Since the people began to bring their contributions into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat and there is plenty left over, because the LORD has blessed His people; this great abundance is what is left over.”
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites about the heaps.
Azariah was the chief priest from the house of Zadok.
Azariah answered Hezekiah.
Azariah said, “The people began to bring their contributions to the house of the LORD.
Since then, we have had enough to eat.
We have been satisfied.
There is much left over.
The LORD has blessed His people.
This great abundance is what remains.”
passages.original: וַיִּדְרֹ֣שׁ יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֛ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם עַל־ הָעֲרֵמֽוֹת׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הָרֹ֖אשׁ לְבֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠יֹּאמֶר מֵהָחֵ֨ל הַתְּרוּמָ֜ה לָבִ֣יא בֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְשָׂב֤וֹעַ וְהוֹתֵר֙ עַד־ לָר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וְהַנּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת־ הֶהָמ֥וֹן הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare storerooms in the house of the LORD, and they did so.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was the king of Judah.
Hezekiah gave a command.
Hezekiah told the people to prepare storerooms.
The storerooms were in the house of the LORD.
The people obeyed Hezekiah.
They prepared the storerooms.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְהָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּכִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: And they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes, and dedicated gifts. Conaniah the Levite was the officer in charge of them, and his brother Shimei was second.
passages.sermon:
The people brought the contributions.
They brought the tithes.
They brought the dedicated gifts.
They did this faithfully.
Conaniah was a Levite.
Conaniah was the officer in charge of these gifts.
Shimei was Conaniah’s brother.
Shimei was second in authority.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ הַתְּרוּמָ֧ה וְהַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וַעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ כּוֹנַנְיָהוּ הַלֵּוִ֔י וְשִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖יהוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the authority of Conaniah and his brother Shimei, by appointment of King Hezekiah and of Azariah the chief official of the house of God.
passages.sermon:
Jehiel was an overseer.
Azaziah was an overseer.
Nahath was an overseer.
Asahel was an overseer.
Jerimoth was an overseer.
Jozabad was an overseer.
Eliel was an overseer.
Ismachiah was an overseer.
Mahath was an overseer.
Benaiah was an overseer.
Conaniah was a Levite.
Shimei was Conaniah’s brother.
Conaniah and Shimei had authority over these overseers.
King Hezekiah appointed them.
Azariah was the chief official of the house of God.
Azariah also appointed them.
passages.original: וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠עֲזַזְיָהוּ וְנַ֨חַת וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִֽירִימ֤וֹת וְיוֹזָבָד֙ וֶאֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְיִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּמַ֖חַת וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִיַּ֤ד כָּונַנְיָהוּ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔יו בְּמִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַעֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts.
passages.sermon:
Kore was the son of Imnah.
Kore was a Levite.
Kore served as the keeper of the East Gate.
Kore was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God.
Kore distributed the contributions to the LORD.
Kore also distributed the consecrated gifts.
passages.original: וְקוֹרֵ֨א בֶן־ יִמְנָ֤ה הַלֵּוִי֙ הַשּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַמִּזְרָ֔חָה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים לָתֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְקָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Under his authority, Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah faithfully distributed portions to their fellow priests in their cities, according to their divisions, old and young alike.
passages.sermon:
Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah served under Kore’s authority.
These men worked in the cities where the priests lived.
They acted with faithfulness.
They gave portions to their fellow priests.
They distributed these portions according to each division.
They gave to every priest, both old and young.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָד֡וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠מִנְיָמִן וְיֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּשְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּעָרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה לָתֵ֤ת לַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ בְּמַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּגָּד֖וֹל כַּקָּטָֽן׃

passages.text: In addition, they distributed portions to the males registered by genealogy who were three years of age or older—to all who would enter the house of the LORD for their daily duties for service in the responsibilities of their divisions— and to the priests enrolled according to their families in the genealogy, as well as to the Levites twenty years of age or older, according to their duties and divisions.
passages.sermon:
The leaders distributed portions to certain people.
They gave portions to males who were registered by genealogy.
These males were three years old or older.
They included all who entered the house of the LORD each day.
These people came to do their daily work.
They served in their assigned duties and divisions.
They also gave portions to the priests.
These priests were listed by their families in the genealogy.
They also gave portions to the Levites.
These Levites were twenty years old or older.
They served in their assigned duties and divisions.
passages.original: מִלְּבַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣ם לִזְכָרִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּלְמַ֔עְלָה לְכָל־ הַבָּ֥א לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה לִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ לַעֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔ם בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖ם כְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ וְאֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּלְמָ֑עְלָה בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בְּמַחְלְקוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The genealogy included all the little ones, wives, sons, and daughters in the whole assembly. For they had faithfully consecrated themselves as holy.
passages.sermon:
The genealogy listed every person in the assembly.
It included all the little children.
It included all the wives.
It included all the sons.
It included all the daughters.
They all belonged to the whole community.
They had faithfully set themselves apart as holy.
passages.original: וּלְהִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּכָל־ טַפָּ֧ם נְשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֥ם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל־ קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶאֱמוּנָתָ֖ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farmlands around each of their cities or in any other city, men were designated by name to distribute a portion to every male among the priests and to every Levite listed by the genealogies.
passages.sermon:
The priests were descendants of Aaron.
They lived on the farmlands around their cities.
They also lived in other cities.
Leaders chose certain men by name.
These men gave a portion to every male among the priests.
They also gave a portion to every Levite listed in the genealogies.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּשְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּכָל־ עִ֣יר וָעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לָתֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְכָל־ זָכָר֙ בַּכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּלְכָל־ הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּלְוִיִּֽם׃

passages.text: So this is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah. He did what was good and upright and true before the LORD his God.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was king in Judah.
Hezekiah acted throughout all Judah.
Hezekiah did what was good.
Hezekiah did what was upright.
Hezekiah did what was true.
Hezekiah did these things before the LORD his God.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ כָּזֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכָל־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ וְהָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: He was diligent in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law and the commandments, in order to seek his God. And so he prospered.
passages.sermon:
Hezekiah was king of Judah.
He began many works.
He served in the house of God.
He worked in the law.
He kept the commandments.
He did all these things to seek his God.
He did every work with all his heart.
He succeeded.
passages.original: וּבְכָֽל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵחֵ֣ל׀ בַּעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וּבַתּוֹרָה֙ וּבַמִּצְוָ֔ה לִדְרֹ֖שׁ לֵֽאלֹהָ֑יו בְּכָל־ לְבָב֥וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחַ׃פ
